main_text.l: Sunt autem vocabula illa, quæ Beda Anglica facit, Germanica omnia. Angli hodie nonnihil variant nam Lunam vocant mone: mensem, moneth: pascha, easter: multram vas, mylkyng payle: ipsum lac multa, meale.
De Britanica veteri, quæ adhuc in Angliæ parte retinetur, Vallica dicta, dicetur inferius.
Oratio Dominica in hodierna lingua Anglica:

Our father, whiche arte in heauen. Halowed be thy name. Thy kyngdome come. Thy wyll be done euen in earthe, as it is in heauen. Giue us thys day our daygly bread. And forgiue us our dettes, as we also forgiue our detters. And leade us not in to temptation. But delyuer us from euyll. For thine is the kingdome, and the power, and the glory for euer, Amen.

Sunt autem vocabula Germanica vel Saxonica omnia, sed aliquo modo detorta, vel immutata, præter substantivum verbum arte & be: & but, id est, sed conjunctionem: & nomen heauen, id est, cœli: & Gallica vocabula dettes ac detters, & delyuer. Audio ante annos aliquot, & patrum memoria multò pauciora Gallica & Latina vocabula in hac lingua fuisse, quæ nunc eis abundant: nam & in colloquiis ea multi affectant,
